result.summary: Found 2 minor accessibility issues related to insufficient color contrast for placeholder and secondary text.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' has insufficient color contrast (low contrast between light gray text and white background).
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet WCAG AA contrast standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).

issues.description: Secondary text such as delivery fees (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') has insufficient color contrast (low contrast between light gray text and white background).
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
